headline: Commission approved September 4, 2026 minutes and decided to place a bench honoring Pam Jones at CVS
summary: The commission reviewed budgets, website compliance, and police citation reports. It decided to place a bench honoring Pam Jones at CVS, discussed Northeast School updates, and looked for small projects to fund. Next regular meeting is set for October 1, 2026.
decisions: Approved the minutes of September 4, 2026 as presented.
Decided to place a bench honoring Pam Jones at CVS.

plain_text:
WALTHAM DISABILITY SERVICES
COMMISSION
110 Pond Street
Waltham Massachusetts 02451 
                               Minutes of REGULAR Meeting
September 4, 2026
The Members of the Disabilities Services Commission met in Regular Session on
September 4, 2026, remotely via ZOOM.  The Chairperson called the remote meeting 
to order at 8:30.   The roll was called by the DSC Chairperson, Mark Johnson, and the 
following members responded as present.       
A roll call of Commission Members for the vote was unanimous, and the Chairperson 
declared the motion carried
Present:                                                                                   Absent:
Mark A. Johnson
JT Graceffa
Jane Demers
Robert Marcou
Adam Mahar
Joann Stone
MINUTES
The DSC reviewed the Minutes of September 4, 2026, meeting.
Upon a motion by Joann Stone and second by Jane Demers it
 was,
VOTED: to approve the minutes of September 4, 2026
                     were accepted as presented.
BUDGET/FINANCES
The Chairperson discussed the current budgets.
DSC WEBSITE
JT will continue to work with the I.T department to assure HP compliance. We will 
also continue to keep the Agenda and Minutes up to date.
POLICE DETAILS
Mark reported receiving 14 HP citations in the previous week. HP Police are using 
handheld units now for ticketing purposes and not using paper.
(Discussions)
PAM JONES BENCH LOCATION 
The commission decided to place a bench in honor of Pam Jones, with consensus to locate it at CVS 
where it would be most utilized by elderly residents. 
NORTHEAST SCHOOL Discussion
JT will keep the commission posted on new developments at the Northeast School
UPCOMING PROJECTS/OTHER ISSUES
The DSC is looking for small City (HP) projects to help fund.
ADJOURNMENT
Upon a motion by Adam Mahar and second by Jane Demers it was,
VOTED: to approve the adjournment
SCHEDULING OF NEXT REGULAR MEETING
There being no apparent scheduling conflict with the routine date for the next Regular 
Meeting, which will be held remotely on October 1, 2026.   The meeting will begin at 
8:30 a.m. via Zoom.
The Disability Services Commission does not meet during the months of January and 
July. 
There being no further business rightly before the Board, upon motion by Adam 
Maher and second Bob Marcou was unanimously voted to adjourn. 
A roll call of Commission Members for the vote was unanimous, and the Chairperson 
declared the motion carried.  The Chairperson declared the meeting adjourned at  9:32
a.m.               
Documents available at the meeting included the June 5, 2026. Minutes which were available for
the August 7, 2026
 meeting.
